finalText:
**React re-renders every child when the parent renders.** Passing the same props does not stop that.

Only `React.memo` makes React check props first. That check compares by identity. A brand new object always counts as different.

So each of these is a new prop every render:

- `<Child data={{ id: 1 }} />` — a fresh object each time.
- `<Child items={[1, 2]} />` — a fresh array each time.
- `<Child onClick={() => save()} />` — a fresh function each time.

The fix is two steps. Wrap the child in `React.memo`, then hold those values steady with `useMemo` or `useCallback`.
